turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: The order on your account is enough, so no receipt is needed. The address we hold is Flat 2, 14 Ardwick Terrace, Manchester.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That address is right. The machine is only two years old, so it is comfortably inside the twelve months.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Understood. Before I book anything, read the collection address back to me.

turns.speaker: user
